authored_assumptions: Original full 3D design assembled from smooth primitives; no external reference.
All joints are authored mechanical pivots with rigid weights, not a simulated linkage constraint system.
The warm bulb is opaque colored geometry, not volumetric light or a luminous beam.
Keyframe rotations and translations are expressed in model rest axes (X right, Y rear, Z up). The builder converts these offsets through each bone rest basis before writing Blender pose transforms.

Revision v2 adds a base-supported rotary stylus with explicit joint motion over a fixed guide. The stylus is lowered only during making_something; no new marks, physical contact simulation or beam illumination are produced.
rest_pose: Authored default bone transforms. Blender Z-up/-Y-front exported to glTF Y-up/+Z-front.
